scenarios.name: Replace a browser query across matching and empty results

scenario_steps.name: a part with origin axes and planes is active in the MCAD Software
X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis are displayed under Origin
the user selects all search text and replaces it with "zzq-nomatch"
the browser displays a no-results message instead of the axis rows
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user selects all search text and replaces it with "plane"
the browser displays YZ Plane, XZ Plane and XY Plane under Origin
the user clears the query and closes the empty search field
the unfiltered browser tree is displayed
